invoice_customers_company_key.value: "invoice_customers"."kind" <> 'company' OR "invoice_customers"."ico" IS NOT NULL OR "invoice_customers"."email_normalized" IS NOT NULL

invoices_issued_has_number.name: invoices_issued_has_number

orders_guest_requires_contact.name: orders_guest_requires_contact

payments_settled_has_time.name: payments_settled_has_time
